articles.title: US jury convicts pastor over Haiti president assassination
articles.description: MIAMI — A federal jury in Miami convicted a Haitian-American pastor on Wednesday of charges related to the 2021 assassination of Haitian president Jovenel Moise. Christian Sanon, 68, was found guilty on multiple charges, including conspiring to murder and kidnap Moise, the Miami Herald reported. A US investigation found that two men leading a Florida-based private security firm called CTU planned to abduct Moise and replace him with Sanon, who wished to become the country’s president.
